_comment: Every conformance suite, described once. test/conformance/run.sh dispatches
from this file, .github/workflows/conformance.yml builds its matrix from it,
and ci-health.yml derives the workflows it monitors from it.
Adding a suite means adding an entry here, not a workflow plus four tables.
JSON rather than YAML so GitHub Actions can fromJSON() it directly and the
runner can read it with jq, which every runner and dev shell already has.
Fields:
profiles       every storage profile the suite's runner accepts
variant        second axis (NFS minor version, SMB auth), or absent
known_failures blacklist path relative to test/; a string when there is one
table, or an object keyed by variant value when a suite
grades each variant against its own table. A value may
be a list of tables graded together (a shared table plus
a per-variant overlay); run.sh passes them to the suite
in DITTOFS_KNOWN_FAILURES, colon-separated.
tiers          profiles to run per GitHub event, defaulting to "defaults";
"all" means every profile the suite has
timeout_minutes  the CI job timeout for one cell of this suite
host_adapter   true when the suite provisions a dfs on the host's NFS
adapter port, so a stale server there would grade it
against the wrong build. Docker-only suites publish no
host port and must not be failed by a listener on it.
steps          ordered steps. Each declares its own privilege need, per
step on purpose, so a step that needs no root stays
runnable without it: nothing may hoist a root
precondition to the whole run.

cthon04.description: Connectathon basic/general/special/lock over named NFS mount option sets

nfstest.description: NetApp nfstest modules over named NFS mount option sets

_workflows_comment: The conformance workflows ci-health.yml monitors, file to display name.
It reads the file names from here; the workflow_run trigger has to repeat
the display names because a GitHub trigger cannot be computed.
